title: “Your broken pieces don’t disqualify you — they’re the very places where Jesus builds your greatest strength.”
paragraphs:
“Your broken pieces don’t disqualify you — they’re the very places where Jesus builds your greatest strength.”
When you finally stop trying to fix everything alone and surrender every shattered part to Him…
power flows where pride ends.
Healing begins where surrender starts.
Grace enters where you let go.

Psalm 34:18 (NIV)
“The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.”
